program: SkyraSoft HBOS Retail Platform & Workforce Integrity Program

production_files_changed.description: Non-destructive schema migration adding business onboarding and profile fields, employee/invitation fields, and business-scoped branch code uniqueness
Added onboarding_status, onboarding_step, onboarding_completed_at, legal_name, website, country, timezone, tax_number fillable attributes and casts
Added employee_code, job_title, hire_date, salary_amount, payment_cycle, next_payment_date, invitation_token, invitation_expires_at, invitation_sent_at, with invitation_token hidden
Added getCreatedByAttribute accessor providing canonical actor attribution parity for sales transactions
Added getUserIdAttribute accessor providing backward-compatible causer attribution resolution
Configured 5 canonical tenant roles: Business Owner (30), Branch Manager (23), Salesperson (8), Accountant (13), Inventory Manager (15). Excluded Platform Super Admin
Implemented resumable 5-step onboarding controller managing Steps 2, 3, 4, 5, defaults initialization, and status reporting
Implemented business-scoped branch code uniqueness validation, automatic creating owner membership attachment, and primary branch deactivation guards
Updated validation rules and persistence for legal_name, website, country, timezone, and tax_number profile attributes
Persisted owner phone on signup, initialized onboarding state defaults, and added acceptInvitation endpoint for single-use invitation token setup
Exposed generated invitation token on employee creation, validated employee profile fields, and enforced token revocation on deactivation
Added material mutation audit logging on sale creation with actor causer attribution, branch scoping, and role-at-action context
Supported 5 canonical tenant roles, prevented privilege escalation to Business Owner/Platform Admin, and implemented cryptographically secure invitation token generation
Registered /onboarding/status, /onboarding/step, and /auth/accept-invitation routes
Fixed hidden error messages, restored .create-btn styling, handled duplicate email/network failures, and redirected successful registration to /businesssetup1 onboarding
Bound business identity form fields to API Step 2 and routed forward to PreferencesView (Step 3/4)
Bound primary branch and business defaults to API Step 3 & 4 and routed to CompleteReviewView (Step 5)
Connected final review submission to API Step 5 completing onboarding and transitioning into dashboard
Reconciled employee interface to canonical /api/v1/users governance API, supporting 5 roles, branches, invitation modal, and non-destructive deactivation
Updated user management role selectors and badge styles to include Accountant and Inventory Manager roles
